releases.name: Super Shooting Gallery Battle
releases.summary: It's a shooting gallery like you've never seen it before! Aim, fire, and battle it out in wild shooting gallery action!

releases.name: Majhi
releases.summary: *** FREE for a limited time ***Code Red is a challenging game that involves you trying to guide a ship through unlimited rounds of moving dots. There are three challenging modes to chose from easy, medium, and hard which will put your skills to the test.Key features:-Fast paced music-Unlimited rounds-3 fun challenging modes-Many awards to unlock

releases.name: Hex Reverse
releases.summary: Let's kick a soccer ball to far away!!This app corresponds to Game Center.And, let's compete flying distance and rivals around the world!Tips to kick to far away1. kick the center of targetIf you kick the edge of the ball, force is not transmitted completely to the ball!2. kick quicklyAfter the run-up is over, and the ball goes up zoom, you can kick the ball immediately.Prefer to kick in the flow of run-up, and ball flies to far away!

releases.name: Heartbeats - Anniversary Edition
releases.summary: The world has gone to hell... Dead roam the land... Survivors flee for their lives... The zombie apocalypse has started - the dead are returning to life and attacking the living. Zombies have chased you across open farmland and you have taken shelter in an abandoned farmhouse. Now you must find a way to escape before it's too late... 'Escape from the Dead' is a classic point and click adventure game. To survive you must find and use objects, solve puzzles and make your escape from the dead! FEATURES: + A classic point & click adventure game, similar to room escape games. + Graphic novel styled visuals. + Atmospheric sound effects and music. + An original and unique storyline featuring a zombie apocalypse. + Many items to collect and puzzles to solve. + Game auto-saves as you progress.

releases.name: Scavenger's March
releases.summary: A semi-idle incremental set in a radioactive wasteland. Your scavenger walks, loots and fights on his own. You choose his upgrades and priorities, occasionally aid with preemptive attacks, turning short, doomed runs into longer expeditions. Hunt ModNoids, buy better weapons and follow the rumours.

releases.name: Incremental Woods
releases.summary: An amazing take on the classic solitaire game of Golf featuring Game Center integration and graphics/sounds optimized for both the iPad and Retina displays. Features: - Fantastically fluid gameplay that is intuitive, responsive, and enjoyable - Compete against the world for the lowest score with Game Center integration - Great graphics, animations, sounds, and music optimized for the iPad and Retina displays - Wild Cards - iPad users get detailed cards and iPhone/iPod touch users get easy to read cards How to play:Golf solitaire is played with a standard 52 card deck where 35 cards have been dealt into 7 columns of 5 cards (the board).  The cards at the bottom of each of the 7 columns are face up.  You can use the stack of 17 remaining cards to remove cards from the board if the card is one lower or one higher than the card you select.  Wild cards can be used to match anything.  The object of the game is to clear the board using as few of the 17 deck cards as possible.  At the end of each of the 9 holes you play any remaining deck cards credit you one stroke while any remaining table cards penalize you one stroke; the lower your score the better you are doing.

releases.name: Hauberk
releases.summary: An acclaimed traditional roguelike, remade with graphics! 50 terrain types, 152 monsters and 171 affixed items to combine — then face the Nameless Unmaker at the bottom of the 100-floor dungeon. Automated exploration lets you focus on stats, skills and gear.

releases.name: Old War Together
releases.summary: How powerful is your brain? Did you always forgot sth.? This game is a brain trainer. It's very interesting and challenging! You should remeber all the symbols and positions in short time, and then you must point out the right position according to the hint. There are 5 modes, number, alphabet, symbol, color and mixture. Each mode trains some part of your brain. Keep on training everyday, your brain will become more powerful!

releases.name: Calcio Totale

releases.name: Maybe Hero
releases.summary: Runners dodge gunfire and capture objectives while Snipers defend the tower from above. Master unpredictable Supply powers, switch between distinct roles, and bring your own painted character into a fast 2–12 player asymmetric multiplayer battle.

releases.name: Super Macabre Madness
releases.summary: Super Macabre Madness is a fast-paced 2D platformer where you’ll die over and over again. Can you beat it before it beats you?

releases.name: The Only Eye: Arcane Legacy
releases.summary: The Only Eye is a 2D pixel-art action roguelite where every run reshapes your journey. Master unique classes, combine powerful relics, face relentless bosses, and push through a dark fantasy world with deep progression and a challenging endgame.

releases.name: Sister Compass: Slow Life Loving with My Sisters on a Deserted Island
Do you remember? (Voider Games)
releases.summary: A realistic-style experience where you are subjected to tests while living a repetitive routine.

releases.name: Obsessive
releases.summary: I WILL JUMP FROM THAT BRIDGE A thought you never wanted, arriving on its own. It only arrived. Cross the bridge and prove it. The man crosses, and enters the village. Then a stone statue that cannot move begins to follow. It closes the distance while you look away. A 1–2 hour Japanese horror game.

releases.name: Ammo Eater
releases.summary: Swallow ammo, grow your black hole, and turn your haul into a boss-busting barrage. Race the clock across colorful arenas, upgrade your collecting power, and unlock new looks in this fast-paced arcade action game.

releases.name: Flockway
releases.summary: Flockway is a colorful 3D animal puzzle game. Drag animals along the direction they face, guide them to the exits, and pair matching arrivals in a limited holding tray. Plan each move carefully to clear the board before the tray fills.

releases.name: LieStar ResiStar
releases.summary: 『LieStar ResiStar』はエネルギーを自分のモノにする力「スタビライズ」を活用する3Dアクションゲームです。管理社会に叛逆する少女ヴィネアを操作し、痛快なアクションで革命を起こすダークヒーローとなれ！

releases.name: Flippy Burgers
releases.summary: Match all the dog pictures as fast as possible, compete with your friends and family and see who can clear all the pictures!

releases.name: Chess Folk
releases.summary: Play offline chess with AI rivals, tournaments, lessons and 2D or 3D boards.

releases.name: Xenmega
releases.summary: Great new game in 3-match genre The simple addictive 3-match based logic game is now available for free in App Store The rules are very simple: you just need to remove some bubbles in the line at each step, others will fall down. If you collect 3 bubbles with the same color, they will be removed and you will get scores. Tune your strategies the more you play. Try Bubbles. if you like logic games - it's fun for all ages!

releases.name: Puzzle Arrows: The Original
releases.summary: Farm animals are out flying!Tap the screen to go up!Release to go down!Get as far as you can!* Compete with friends for the highest score using GameCenter! *
